purpose: Phase-8A selection-pressure model. Selection pressure depends on treatment pressure, differential subpopulation sensitivity, effective exposure, duration, population loss, survivor composition, microenvironment protection, and treatment interruptions. CRITICAL: selection pressure NEVER creates a new mechanism - it only changes RELATIVE population composition. Ordinal states + a bounded scalar. Schematic only.

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic selective pressure the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: net treatment pressure x differential subpopulation sensitivity (predicted)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: selection_pressure_value drives enrichment strength in the population-enrichment registry; it does not add cytotoxic loss.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No selection coefficient or fitness value (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.no_mechanism_creation: Selection redistributes existing subpopulation fractions; it never invents a resistance mechanism.
rules.no_duplicate_loss: Selection alters composition only; cytotoxic loss is owned by the Phase-6 engines and is not duplicated here.
rules.needs_difference: With no differential subpopulation sensitivity, selection pressure is 'absent' (validation rejects selection claimed without differential sensitivity).
